full-stack-development.name: Samrita KC
full-stack-development.bio: Meet Samrita KC, Full Stack mentor at Next Minds. They guide learners through React, Node.js, and database design, turning first lines of code into deployed, production-ready web applications.

digital-marketing.name: Pratik Sharma
digital-marketing.bio: Meet Pratik Sharma, Digital Marketing mentor at Next Minds. They guide learners through paid campaigns, funnel strategy, and analytics, turning marketing theory into measurable business growth.

advanced-seo.name: Ujjwal Thapa
advanced-seo.bio: Meet Ujjwal Thapa, SEO mentor at Next Minds. They guide learners through technical audits, link building, and search data analysis, turning ranking theory into pages that actually reach page one.

qa-engineering.name: Nabin Shrestha
qa-engineering.bio: Meet Nabin Shrestha, QA Engineering mentor at Next Minds. They guide learners through test design, automation frameworks, and release workflows, turning careful thinking into software that ships without surprises.

cyber-security.name: Suman Adhikari
cyber-security.bio: Meet Suman Adhikari, Cyber Security mentor at Next Minds. They guide learners through ethical hacking concepts, security practices, and hands-on cybersecurity techniques to turn curiosity into practical digital defense skills.

devops-engineering.name: Roshan Bhattarai
devops-engineering.bio: Meet Roshan Bhattarai, DevOps mentor at Next Minds. They guide learners through containers, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure, turning manual deployments into automated, reliable delivery.

ui-ux-design.name: Alina Shakya
ui-ux-design.bio: Meet Alina Shakya, UI/UX Design mentor at Next Minds. They guide learners through research, wireframing, and design systems, turning rough ideas into interfaces people genuinely enjoy using.

data-science-ai.name: Anita Maharjan
data-science-ai.bio: Meet Anita Maharjan, Data Science & AI mentor at Next Minds. They guide learners through Python, machine learning, and model deployment, turning raw datasets into insights and working AI solutions.
